title: Starter Timeline
subtitle: Template starter guidance
body: First 10 minutes: Open the admin setup Index page. Confirm PlayerCore permissions and home rules. Run the first RuntimeGuard budget check. First 30 minutes: Create a shared HoloMap objective marker. Complete the admin setup MissionCore checklist. Review backup and diagnostics docs. Choose server-balanced or low-end config guidance. First 2 hours: Write staff-specific permission notes. Add one shared community objective mission. Recheck RuntimeGuard budgets after player count assumptions change.
